body:
S471 backend — provider-stall watchdog. Implementing the resilience fix the
owner asked for (from the S471 latency diagnosis): the social fast path now
emits provider_call_start (with started_at) / provider_first_byte obs events,
and _heartbeat_status_text distinguishes a no-first-byte QUEUE stall from
slow generation — names the provider, and past 30s escalates to a
switch-model offer. No abort (the provider may still answer), no adapter
behavior change, no new timers. Paths are strictly backend + backend tests;
zero overlap with Omari's (S472) frontend thinking-block formatting work.
